text:
Type: round mirror with steel frame
Use: grooming, bouncing light; bathroom, hallway, living room, bedroom
Style: modern, minimalist, industrial
Materials: mirror glass in a thin brushed stainless steel frame
Colors: silver reflective glass, brushed steel grey
Shape: perfect circle with a slim raised metal rim wrapping the edge, flat to the wall, light and clean visual weight
Feel: sleek, crisp, bright, airy
Goes with: chrome or steel fittings, white tiles, black accents, light wood; modern, minimalist or industrial rooms

product.name: GRUNDTAL
product.description: The mirror comes with safety film on the back, which reduces the risk of injury if the glass is broken.
